paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Sunday, batted 5th and started at 3B for Minnesota Twins against Milwaukee Brewers. Minnesota Twins fell to Milwaukee Brewers, 3-4.

Brooks Lee's home run — his 17th of the season came in the fifth inning, when he turned around on a 1-1 pitch a 99 mph four-seam fastball from Jacob Misiorowski. The swing moved the score from 0-1 to 1-1. Statcast measured the ball at 103.8 mph off the bat, a 29-degree launch angle, 401 feet.
Brooks Lee went 2-for-5, 1 home run, 1 RBI, 1 run scored.
